key_idea: Try a number of right days and check if she ends with 10 more coins.
steps: Try 4 right days: she wins 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 16 coins.
Then 7 - 4 = 3 days are wrong: she pays 2 + 2 + 2 = 6 coins.
16 - 6 = 10. She has 10 more coins. It works!

choice_feedback.A: She wins 8 coins and pays 10, so she loses 2 coins.
choice_feedback.B: She wins 12 coins and pays 8, so she gains only 4 coins.
choice_feedback.D: She wins 20 coins and pays 4, so she gains 16 coins.
choice_feedback.E: She wins 24 coins and pays 2, so she gains 22 coins.
